items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Here’s these muscle men, I mean these are Charles Atlas, Man Mountain, Montana guys.

ctx.x: I didn’t have to go, or, I didn’t.

Well the night that I — I took my pre-induction physical in Jacksonville, Florida. We were playing at the Cape Colony Inn which was owned, it was in Coco Beach, Florida, which was owned by the astronauts. And a trumpet player, Paul Squire drove me up there. My father said, “I’ve never wished you any bad luck in your life,” he says, “but now I hope you fail this one.” And man, I stayed up all night. We did every single thing we could put our hands on, including any controlled substance I could put my hands on,…
